question: What initiatory status can the mūrti-yāga confer and in which scripture is this teaching given?
premises: Through the mūrti-yāga a person can become a vow-holder.
This can occur even without the mandala rite.
The teaching is attributed to the Siddhayogīśvarīmata.
inference: The mūrti-yāga has initiatory power sufficient to establish vow-holder status, as taught in the Siddhayogīśvarīmata.
plain_english: Through the mūrti-yāga, even without the mandala rite, a person can become a vow-holder; thus is the mūrti-yāga taught in the revered Siddhayogīśvarīmata.
